inlines.v: COOLLY, adverb 1. Without heat or sharp cold. 2. In a cool or indifferent manner; not cordially; without passion or ardor. He was coolly received at court. 3. Without haste; calmly; deliberately. The design was formed coolly and executed with firmness.
